tasks.spec:
You are a Python 3.12 engineer fixing a narration-prompt defect in freytag-forge, approved by Brandon (plan: .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback-plan.md; evidence: .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback/probe2-prereg.md Result, read it). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (branch 1a-opening-and-truck-feedback). No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit.

YOU MAY EDIT: storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py, storygame/runtime/item_facts.py, a NEW tests/test_boarding_turn_prompt.py, and existing tests under tests/ ONLY where a pin truly changes because of this fix (list each in your report). Never edit data/, docs/, bench/, packages/, .plans/, scripts/. Shared runtime has NO story names (no Kristin, Michelle, truck, laptop, driver, passenger, drawer): every string must be built from world names, the protagonist name, and generic words. The fix must be general: no command keyword tables and no wording tied to the commands in the plan's transcript.

THE DEFECT (measured live): on a committed boarding turn (the protagonist was just seated in a vehicle's seat by the engine), the narrator prompt's PLAYER block carries the player's raw movement phrase next to 'Already done: <protagonist> sat down in the <seat>.' A model reads 'head out to the truck' / 'go to the truck' after being seated as leaving or driving: 12 of 12 control replies had her step out of the truck, and 3 of 8 for another phrasing started the engine and drove. Removing the raw phrase and adding a SCENE fact that everything inside the vehicle is reachable from the seat gave 20 of 20 replies that stay seated and parked and show the item on the other seat.

CHANGE A (item_facts.py, ItemFactsProvider._player_lines, observation branch): when self.observation_request.kind == 'enter' AND self._observation_completed_actions() is non-empty (a boarding step was performed this turn), do NOT emit the raw action line; the PLAYER block keeps the protagonist place line(s) and the 'Already done: ...' line. In every other case (kind != 'enter', or no completed boarding step, e.g. an already-aboard turn) behavior is byte-identical to today. Check the other readers of observation_request.action (verifier, completion checks) still get the original action unchanged.

CHANGE B (cloudflare.py, CloudflareTurnProvider._where_line and wherever the where line becomes a SCENE bullet): when the protagonist is seated (the existing seated branch) and, per World.reachable_from_seat(seat_id, protagonist_id) (packages/worldkeeper/src/worldkeeper/model.py), the vehicle holds at least one visible entity other than the seat entities, the vehicle itself and the protagonist, add a second SCENE bullet directly after the where bullet: '<protagonist name> can reach anything inside <vehicle name> from the <seat name>.' using exactly the same name variables the where line uses (do not use pronouns). Example shape only: 'X can reach anything inside Y from the Z.' If the SCENE renderer takes one string for this line, make the smallest change so a second bullet is rendered immediately after (preferred) and explain; if that is not feasible, append the sentence to the same bullet and explain. No bullet when the protagonist is not seated, and none when nothing else is inside the vehicle. If you find a world-state-only predicate is needed, add it as a World method in packages/worldkeeper with tests there instead of storygame logic, but only if truly needed (reachable_from_seat likely suffices; do NOT edit packages/ unless you must, and then say why).

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_boarding_turn_prompt.py (hermetic, no network; copy the product-wired approach from tests/test_boarding_engine_text.py or tests/test_observation_prompt.py: WorldCapture attached, scripted question answers, stubbed provider dispatch): (a) the continuity-initiative package, route 'open the drawer','feel in the gap','head out to the truck' with boarding answered yes: the narrator user text for the boarding turn has the reach bullet right after the where bullet, contains 'Already done:', contains the place line, and does NOT contain a PLAYER line equal to '- head out to the truck'; (b) the same with 'go to the truck'; (c) an unboarded turn (boarding answered no): PLAYER still carries the raw command and no reach bullet and no 'Already done:'; (d) a second consecutive 'get in the truck' (already aboard): PLAYER keeps its raw line exactly as before this change; (e) a synthetic second story package with differently named vehicle, seat and item (use the existing synthetic-package helpers in tests/test_seating.py, tests/test_boarding.py or tests/test_world_seats.py): analogous reach bullet built from its names, raw command dropped on the boarding turn; (f) vehicle with nothing else inside: no reach bullet; (g) protagonist not seated: no reach bullet. Update existing tests that pin the old boarding prompt shape ONLY with the minimal assertion change, and list them.

DONE WHEN the check passes. Report: files changed, existing tests updated and why, how the second bullet is rendered, and anything you could not do.
